patterns.regex: ICICI Bank Acc(?:oun)?t [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) debited for (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}); (?<merchant>.+?) credited\. UPI:(?<ref>\d+)
Acc(?:oun)?t [xX*]*(?<account>\d{3,6}) is credited with (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}) from (?<merchant>.+?)\. UPI:(?<ref>\d+)

(?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) spent using ICICI Bank Card [xX*]*(?<account>\d{4}) on (?<date>\d{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\d{2}) on (?<merchant>.+?)\. Avl Limit: (?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)
